projects.name: Bonfire
projects.description:
Bonfire is a place for you and your friends to chat without prying eyes. Privacy-focused, cross-platform, and self-hostable.

Bonfire puts the trust in the users, not a central authority. It can even be used offline on the local network. Your login data and settings are stored on your own device, and everything else is per-server.

projects.name: Gif Off!
projects.description: Gif Off is an interactive game in which users are presented with a randomly selected question from a set of predefined packs. Players must select a GIF image from Tenor as the most suitable response to the question. Once all responses have been submitted, users vote on the best response, and are rewarded with points for each vote they receive.

projects.name: Auto Chaos
projects.description:
Auto Chaos is a multiplayer, procedurally generated racing game.

You have 3 respawns, falling off of the map or getting stuck will cause you to respawn, if you run out of respawns, you will spectate the leading player, and the last player alive wins.

You can earn respawns via checkpoints during the race. Every track is infinite, and once you get far into the map, it begins to rain, increasing the difficulty, and eventually begins snowing, further increasing the difficulty. This game is in alpha and was originally made for the PROCJAM game jam, but will be updated. Bugs may be present. If you have any ideas or discover any bugs, I will be more than happy to help, here are a few ways to contact me.

projects.name: Node Widgets
projects.description:
Node Widgets is a cross-platform desktop widget software, inspired by Rainmeter.
It allows you to create/use custom interact-able widgets using ReactJS and Electron.

Rainmeter is a great program, but I find it really obnoxious that the language used to create skins is .ini, and I decided to make a similar concept using Electron.
